summary.intent: Fix a broken Docker build in the CI tag-staging-release workflow caused by the latest release adding a new @cipherbox/crypto dependency to the API package without updating the Dockerfile.
summary.outcome: Identified the missing COPY directives in apps/api/Dockerfile, added the crypto package to the build context, committed as a chore(ci) commit on a chore/ branch, and pushed with a PR.

repo: The API Dockerfile uses pnpm workspace filtering (--filter @cipherbox/api...) which resolves workspace deps but requires all dep source directories to be explicitly COPYed into the container.
packages/crypto uses tsup to bundle ESM-only dependencies into a CJS output, which is required for the API to import it at build time.
The crypto package's tsconfig.json extends a base config.
Release tags follow the pattern @cipherbox/<pkg>-v<semver> and are created via release-please.

code.finding: Three additions required: COPY packages/crypto/package.json before pnpm install, COPY packages/crypto/ source before build, and an explicit pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build step before building the API.
tsup bundles all deps into the CJS output, meaning the API can import @cipherbox/crypto without needing crypto's node_modules at API build time — but the crypto package itself must be built first.

workflow: Branch naming convention is chore/<description> for CI/tooling fixes.
Commit message convention is chore(ci): <description> for CI-related changes.
When a monorepo package gains a new intra-workspace dependency, any Dockerfiles that manually COPY package sources must be audited and updated.

friction: The Dockerfile was never updated alongside the dependency addition in the same release commit, creating a silent CI failure only caught post-tag.
The pnpm --filter flag's workspace dependency expansion gives no warning when source directories are absent from the Docker context — it just fails at install time.
open_items: Consider adding a CI lint step or script that validates all workspace dependencies of a package are present in its Dockerfile COPY directives to prevent this class of regression.
